extraction.Name: Emma Tway
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but that she was scared into taking it, having been told that the issuance of the patent had been reported to the tax commission and was told that if the taxes were not paid, that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Recorded patent: she never had the patent recorded and does not think it ever was
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was unable to pay the taxes and was about to lose the land so she sold it for $1200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: has to depend on the wages her husband can earn, working on the railroad
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health; has no home; has four small children depending on her for support; deponent states she thinks the land was worth about $2400.00 but had to take what she could get; document dated November 9, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
